rsp+0x78 is initialized NULL and passed by address as third argument to journal_submit_commit_record; its output is loaded into r14, checked, has dirty cleared, and is passed to __wait_on_buffer. Return branches to buffer_uptodate test and buffer reference release. This is the inlined cbh wait path.
